description: This Java source file defines the CheckInAndDeleteDataItemsService class, an Android IntentService responsible for handling location-based notification actions such as checking in and deleting data items within a geofencing context. It manages GoogleApiClient connections to interact with the Wearable Data API to delete specific data items upon user actions or notification dismissals.

classes.name: CheckInAndDeleteDataItemsService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles 'Check In' actions and notification dismissals in a geofencing context, managing interactions with Google Play Services' Wearable API to delete DataItems and providing user feedback via confirmation animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and sets up connection callbacks.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents to handle check-in actions or delete data items; manages GoogleApiClient connection and deletion of DataItems.

methods.name: startConfirmationActivity
methods.description: Starts a confirmation animation activity on the wearable device with specified animation type and message.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient has connected (empty implementation).

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is suspended (empty implementation).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection fails (empty implementation).
